long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Istanbul in 1973, Bahri Sinan Pulat grew up in an established corporate family: his father, Yusuf Yüksel Pulat, sat on Koç Holding's board and chaired its executive committee. Pulat studied mechanical engineering at Istanbul Technical University and completed a master's degree at GMI Engineering and Management Institute in the United States.

Agrico, the Turkish partner in a venture with Denmark's Knud Jepsen, moved from agricultural-equipment trading into greenhouse production. Operating as Queen Türkiye, the venture developed large-scale flower, cutting and young-plant operations, with Pulat as general director and later chief executive. By 2023 it covered 178,000 square metres and employed 400 people. Beyond business, Pulat made dozens of Turkish rally starts over roughly a decade and serves on the Six Dots Foundation for the Blind's board.

Identity is resolved cumulatively. The authoritative record gives Sinan Pulat, Turkish nationality and Turkish residence. Queen's official directory gives B. Current bank and surveying professionals with the same short name have incompatible careers and locations.

Bahri is the first element of Pulat's documented full given name, not a conventional middle name following Sinan. Proposing it into the upstream middle_names field would risk rendering the name in the wrong order as Sinan Bahri Pulat, so the field remains unproposed even though the full public name is used in the biographies.

The exact birth day and month come from a specialist motorsport database rather than a civil or first-party biographical record. Confidence remains high because the full-name foundation biography corroborates the year and maritime reporting independently identifies the yacht-linked Sinan Pulat as a recognised motorsport figure.

Agriculture is a medium-confidence reasoned wealth-creation classification. Sources establish Pulat's founder and long-running executive roles in a substantial horticulture venture, but do not publish his equity percentage, personal net worth or a direct attribution of fortune. Agriculture is very-high confidence as his current primary industry because Queen's official directory identifies him as current chief executive.

Founder is supported by Plant Dergisi's explicit statement that Pulat and Lars Korup established the joint venture, In Greenhouses' identification of Agrico as the Turkish partner and Queen's current leadership record. Queen Türkiye's official history separately says Korup led the 2010 establishment and does not enumerate Pulat or Agrico. The evidence therefore supports Founder at medium confidence, not an ownership percentage or sole-founder claim.

Self-made — advantaged start preserves both sides of the public record: Pulat helped form a separate horticulture platform, while the family notices identify his father as a senior Koç Holding leader. The evidence establishes material family status and likely access but not inheritance, seed capital or a transfer into Queen Türkiye.

Forbes, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube, TikTok and personal-website searches produced no personal profile meeting the identity contract. A LinkedIn directory entry naming Sinan Pulat at Agrico lacks a stable direct personal-profile URL and is not proposed. Queen Türkiye's verified official domain is proposed only as a Company Website.

Rallying is the sole active tag assigned because the decade-long, 38-entry competitive record satisfies its binding sporting-identity contract. Motorsport and Racing driver would add redundant broader overlap. Agriculture, floriculture, agricultural executive and related catalogue entries are inactive and therefore remain ordinary research and classification facts; no taxonomy candidate is created.
